uf088_canonical_fixture_crosscheck.method: Re-run of CANONICAL_FIXTURE_CROSSCHECK.json against the post-remediation concept, same corpora definition and same literal/equivalence matching, plus one declared extension (derived_field).

method_detail.dom_corpus: innerText of all 13 room panes at ADVANCED disclosure with every More group expanded, plus the scope picker list and footer, the read-only Usage settings sheet, the context ring popover, the context-details popover for thread:t-88 and thread:t-91, run detail for run:goal-47 and run:plan-12, and the attempt inspector for ue-501, ue-091, ue-520, ue-611, ue-541 and ue-606
method_detail.data_corpus: bounded cycle-safe walk of window.U11, depth 9, 4MB cap, recording key names, scalar values and key:value pairs
method_detail.matching: literal case-insensitive substring; key half and value half of key:value tokens recorded separately
method_detail.equivalence: camelCase(key half) or the literal snake_case key present as a KEY in the data walk
method_detail.declared_extension: derived_field records canonical fields produced only by a U11 accessor (tokenBucketsOf, the cmd.nav.open_usage_subject payload) rather than by a static property; it scored 0 additional tokens because every such field is also reachable as a static key

uf088_canonical_fixture_crosscheck.honest_reading: 47 of 79 canonical MUST facts now have an equivalent field in the concept's data model (audit: 9), 38 appear literally in the data as canonical snake_case (audit: 0), and 2 appear literally in the rendered DOM (audit: 2, unchanged). Counting any of the three measures, 50 of 79 are represented and 29 remain absent everywhere. The remaining absences concentrate in GUI-CBP-001 (7 of 8 absent) and GUI-CBP-002 (5 of 6 absent) — the Antigravity slash-command and G1-credits vocabulary, which finding A07-07 already records as wholly unimplemented — plus GUI-RAW-001 (4 of 8) and GUI-RAP-001 (3 of 5). Literal DOM presence did not move, because the concept renders prose rather than canonical field names; the gain is entirely in the data model.

side_effect_disclosure.what: Running `node u11-verify.mjs` to re-verify the harness independently rewrote the concept's own report at Concepts/usage-concepts/QwenUsageConcept/reports/visual-interaction-test-report.json, which this pass was not supposed to edit.
side_effect_disclosure.measured_impact: Two consecutive runs of the harness were diffed field by field. Only `ran_at` and `duration_ms` differ between runs. The 90 case names, all 90 verdicts and every per-case detail string are byte-identical and deterministic, and pass/fail is 90/0 in both.
side_effect_disclosure.net_change_to_the_concept: ran_at moved to the time of this pass's run and duration_ms to that run's elapsed time. No verdict, case, count or detail string was altered.
side_effect_disclosure.not_reverted: The pre-run bytes were not captured before the first run, so the two timestamp fields cannot be restored exactly. Disclosed here rather than silently left.
